title: Puente Nacional, military report 'en clave', 6 June 1832 (CEHM-Carso I-2.5.340.1, catalogue 1466)

steps.what: CEHM catalogue image URL (visor.cehm.org.mx/jzd/...) returned 404; the viewer in Chrome loads /assets/docx/fondos/jzd/... which curl fetches with a Referer.
Transcribed the 22 cipher lines from enhanced crops; 20 words left unread.
Consonant skeletons matched Spanish words (comunicacion, recibido, movimiento, Jalapa, cinco o seis dias); fixed a = dash, e = i, i = x, o = dot, u = u.
lm.best_language on the decode ranked es-modern first (-1.70 against -2.23 for the next).
Checked CEHM records 33468-33472: I-2.5.341.1 is a letter of J. A. Facio, 15 June 1832, in clear; no key or sibling cipher.
One web search on the item and Plan of Veracruz 1832: no cipher literature found.

validation.notes: Vowel substitution found by hand from word shapes; the transcription is by word, not aligned sign by sign to a key table, so the token-level test cannot run

outcome.method_basis: The vowel substitution was found from word shapes in the ciphertext alone and the decode ranks as Spanish; no external plaintext was used.
outcome.fraction_read_source: transcription.txt, cipher words of lines 1-22: 127 of 147 without a [?]

gaps.item: line 4 (about five words) and the words after 'que oc' in line 3
words in lines 5, 8, 10, 14, 17, 19 and the Sr. named in line 10

texts.summary: A report sent from Puente Nacional, Veracruz, on the evening of 6 June 1832, to an officer styled V.E. (the text names Jalapa): a section was to leave at dawn, no movement has been made or planned in that direction, the writer hopes for a combination of these forces with those leaving Jalapa, and resources last five or six days. Setting in the 1832 civil conflict is the editor's inference.

reading_review.note: Read as sentences with holes: lines 1-2, 6-7, 9, 11-13, 15-16 and 20-21 read cleanly; lines 3-5, 8, 10, 14, 17-19 and 22 carry gaps. Self-review by the model, not an independent Spanish reader.

outcome.notes: Partly read; the gaps are words the cursive does not settle at this scan resolution.
